uncovered.subject: likelihood_permille (all items)

uncovered.subject: sprinklered_permille (all types)
uncovered.why: The Code states triggers (24 m habitable height, compartment limits), not shares of the stock.

uncovered.subject: rail_station sprinklers, smoke control, traction power
uncovered.why: Stations follow the CPFPRTS, which was not accessed.

uncovered.why: No allowed source gave a value.

uncovered.why: Licensed references not accessed; WS9 5.19 planning values kept and new rules' values Assumed.

uncovered.why: Only kitchens and sprinklers could be sourced.
